extraction_notes: Records include Table 1 printed rates/TOFs and readable stability data points from Figure 2a. Figure 2b reports Arrhenius plots as ln r versus 1000/T and activation energies; no rate values were extracted from it because converting ln r to rates would require calculation. Literature-comparison data said to be in Table S2 and SI tables/figures were not included because they are not present in the supplied text.
